Class PriceHistoryClient

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.quote.PriceHistoryClient
@Component public class PriceHistoryClient extends Object
Fetches candle history and latest prices from the market data service, for valuing holdings over time. The caller's own bearer token is forwarded because the market data endpoints are JWT-secured.

  • Method Details

    • fetchCloses

      public List<PriceHistoryClient.CandleClose> fetchCloses(String symbol, OffsetDateTime from, OffsetDateTime to, int intervalSeconds)
      Fetches every candle close for a symbol within a time range, oldest first.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the instrument symbol
      from - the start of the range
      to - the end of the range
      intervalSeconds - the candle width, in seconds (60, 300, 3600 or 86400)
      Returns:
      the candle closes in the range, oldest first; empty if the symbol has no history
      Throws:
      QuoteUnavailableException - if the market data service could not be reached or returned an error

    • fetchCloses

      public List<PriceHistoryClient.CandleClose> fetchCloses(String symbol, OffsetDateTime from, OffsetDateTime to, int intervalSeconds, String bearerToken)
      Fetches every candle close for a symbol within a time range, oldest first, authenticating with the given token instead of the caller's. For work that runs outside any request.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the instrument symbol
      from - the start of the range
      to - the end of the range
      intervalSeconds - the candle width, in seconds (60, 300, 3600 or 86400)
      bearerToken - the JWT to send to the market data service
      Returns:
      the candle closes in the range, oldest first; empty if the symbol has no history
      Throws:
      QuoteUnavailableException - if the market data service could not be reached or returned an error

    • fetchLatestPrice

      public Optional<BigDecimal> fetchLatestPrice(String symbol)
      Fetches the latest simulated price for a symbol.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the instrument symbol

      the latest price, or empty if the market data service does not know the symbol
      Throws:
      QuoteUnavailableException - if the market data service could not be reached or returned an error
